headline: Fuel prices rising, filling up increasingly expensive in Sicily: the proposal to stop the increases
summary: Fuel costs in Sicily and Italy continue to rise even after excise duty cuts were extended several times. Confimprenditori has proposed measures to stop the increases.
why: Excise duties are a major component of retail fuel prices in Italy, so changes to them directly affect transport and business costs.
